sectors.name: Logistics
themes: Indonesia's port infrastructure upgrades and downstreaming policy are structurally rerouting domestic cargo flows, benefiting integrated logistics operators with port-side assets.
The global container shipping rate recovery, driven by Red Sea rerouting and capacity discipline, is lifting freight-forwarder and ship-owner margins, a durable cycle for SHIP and TAMU.
E-commerce penetration in tier-2/3 cities is forcing last-mile consolidation, favoring players with cold-chain and rural networks like HUMI and SDMU, a multi-year volume growth story.
sectors.ai: Logistics is breaking out on volume, led by GTSI and SOCI, with broad-based gains across shipping and distribution names. The US-listed cohort outperforming ID-listed peers signals global trade tailwinds, not just domestic noise. Add exposure on pullbacks to 5-day moving averages; momentum is intact, and the WATCH signal upgrades to BUY if GTSI holds above +8% weekly.
